lead.title: Anthropic proposes law regulating AI to US lawmakers
lead.summary: Anthropic, the creator of the AI assistant Claude, confirmed on Friday it is circulating a draft bill among US lawmakers aimed at regulating artificial intelligence to address the lack of federal legislation on the risks posed by the new technology.

secondary.title: Chip maker Nvidia shares climb as AI demand stays strong
secondary.summary: Shares rose after the company said demand for AI chips remains high. Investors are watching supply limits closely.

stories.title: Pope to return to Vatican after cancer surgery
stories.summary: Pope Leo XIV will leave the Rome hospital where he has been recovering from lung cancer surgery , the Vatican said on Saturday, after doctors deemed him “fit for discharge”.
